name: Small Stone Shard
summary: Small Stone Shards come from lesser rock elementals in the Badlands. Lotwil Veriatus needs them to test spells and devices for his elemental binding work.

sections.title: Stone for Study
sections.body: Lesser rock elementals in the hills west of Lotwil Veriatus carry Small Stone Shards. The mage gathers them for tests of his offensive spells and the devices he has assembled. He is working on shackles meant to bind elementals, and these shards are among the materials he needs.

faq.q: Where do Small Stone Shards come from?
faq.answer: You take them from the lesser rock elementals that roam the hills west of Lotwil Veriatus.
Lotwil Veriatus needs Small Stone Shards for his work on elemental binding and his tests of spells and devices.

faq.q: What are the shards used for?
faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus uses Small Stone Shards to test offensive spells and devices for his work on shackles of elemental binding.
Lotwil Veriatus is working in the Badlands, with lesser rock elementals in the hills immediately to the west.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see Lotwil Veriatus testing offensive spells and devices as he works on shackles for binding elementals.
